Exact date, port and embarkation all agree. The Francesca Prostamo on the same voyage is now IDENTIFIED: she is his daughter, born 1945 at Briatico, aged twelve. The tree records no crossing for her at all -- she travelled with her father. CORRECTED 20 SEPTEMBER -- THE PORT AND DATE IN THIS ROW ARE NOW THE DEBARKATION, NOT THE LANDFALL. The ROMA first touched Australia at FREMANTLE on 10 OCTOBER 1957, which is what the passenger index records and what the tree copied. He did not get off there. NAA: BP25/1, the BRISBANE aliens series, records him and Francesca arriving at BRISBANE on the T/v ROMA on 21 OCTOBER 1957 -- eleven days after the ship's first Australian landfall. The passenger index gives the voyage; the aliens registration gives the man. The family settled in Queensland, which is what the second date says.
